paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, parashat Tisa, 9: he spoke in the name of his father.[^1]

notes.text: All three heading titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. The inherited bei rendering of בי is retained without turning it into an additional independently established genealogy; בר׳ marks son of R' Yaakov. The body reports in his father’s name. Pesikta Rabbati, Tisa9 remains the literal source locator without a verified modern mapping or independently verified attribution. The older note’s use of printed refers here only to the supplied digital label; no printed page was inspected.
